category.reason: The correct favorite control must be distinguished from the other category controls by the clown on its cover.

instruction.en: Add the category whose cover shows a clown to favorites.
instruction.zh: 收藏封面图是小丑的类目。

reference.patch: Replaced the original instruction “Click on the list icon to view categories.” with an instruction to favorite the category whose cover shows a clown, and added instruction.zh by translating the revised English instruction. Changed groundTruth from [73.8, 954.0, 199.8, 828.0] to [900, 521, 951, 470] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, moving the target from the categories list icon to the favorite star on the clown category. Updated category.item and category.reason to reflect selection among similar favorite controls.
